delta_from_v12: Produce request TopicData.Name compact string (versions 0-12) is replaced by TopicData.TopicId UUID (versions 13+).
Produce response Responses.Name compact string (versions 0-12) is replaced by Responses.TopicId UUID (versions 13+).
UNKNOWN_TOPIC_ID (100) may be returned and must refresh metadata and retry within the original delivery budget.
The compact record/partition arrays, transactional ID, acks, timeout, records, v10 CurrentLeader and NodeEndpoints tags and throttle fields retain the v12 layouts.
The v12 transaction-V2 behavior remains applicable; topic IDs do not authorize transaction-V2 operation on a broker without that feature.
runtime_requirements: Cache nonzero IDs from Metadata and preserve the sent mapping per in-flight request.
Resolve response UUIDs through that request snapshot, preserving public topic names and per-record callbacks.
On stale ID error, refresh the ID before retrying; avoid duplicate acknowledgements or offset confusion when a topic is recreated.
Retain name-based v3-v12 negotiation for older brokers and fail clearly when required IDs cannot be resolved.
compatibility: Existing public ProduceTopicData and ProducePartitionResponse struct layouts can remain unchanged through explicit identity-aware codec helpers. No zero UUID substitution may masquerade as v13 runtime support.
java_sender_semantics: Snapshot topic ID to name map before installing response callback; recreated topics do not reinterpret in-flight responses.
Transaction V1 uses maximum Produce11; transaction V2 can use12/13.
Java may construct zero IDs when missing metadata; this implementation must not treat zero as resolved v13 runtime identity.
TransactionManager enables transactionV2 only when finalized transaction.version >=2; supported API ranges alone are insufficient.

runtime_contract.transaction_mode: Fixed initialization snapshot: finalized transaction.version >=2 plus EndTxn v5 enables transactionV2. Otherwise Produce <=11, EndTxn/TxnOffsetCommit <=4 and explicit transaction partition/offset registration. Recreate producer after feature changes; no dynamic feature upgrade claimed.
